'''Shuttle TY922''' was a stolen [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] piloted by [[Kanan Jarrus]] and [[Captain]] [[Rex]] during the attempt to rescue the [[Fulcrum]] [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] from [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Chimaera|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="TIE" />

==Description==
As a [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]], Shuttle TY992 had a tri-wing design. It was also capable of hyperspace travel and could carry several passengers.<ref name="TIE" />

==History==
Shuttle TY992 was acquired by the rebellion during the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]]. In [[2 BBY]], the rebels [[Kanan Jarrus]] and [[Rex]] used the shuttle as part of the secondary phase of a [[Rescue of Alexsandr Kallus|mission]] to rescue the rogue [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]]. While their initial plan was to rescue Kallus from [[Lieutenant]] [[Yogar Lyste]]'s [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]], Kanan and Rex were forced to change their plans after Lyste brought [[Ezra Bridger]] aboard [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Star Destroyer]] ''[[Chimaera]]''.<ref name="TIE" />

After [[C1-10P|Chopper]] obtained the necessary clearance codes, Rex and Kanan were able to land in the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[hangar]] bay. Following a brief fight involving [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] and Lieutenant Lyste, Rex and Kanan managed to reunite with Ezra and the droids Chopper and [[AP-5]]. However, Kallus elected to stay behind to continue helping the rebels from behind Imperial lines.<ref name="TIE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shuttle TY992 first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|Season Three]] episode "[[Through Imperial Eyes]]," which first premiered on [[February 25]], [[2017]].
